Yes. **`continue-security-fixes`** (`wfrun_msaoj0cc_a2`, 16 hops, **done**) landed real code — not just an audit.

## What got fixed

| Issue | Status | Evidence in tree |
|---|---|---|
| **Broker `?key=` tokens** | **Fixed** | Headers-only `extractToken`; query-only → 400 |
| **Broker always on loopback TCP** | **Fixed** | Unix-only default on Linux; `allowLoopbackTcp` / env opt-in |
| **Ledger HMAC 16-char keys** | **Fixed** | ≥32-byte floor + low-entropy reject; `tests/ledger-keys.test.ts` |
| **`ensureOwnerOnly*` no uid/ancestors** | **Fixed** | `src/runtime/trusted-path.ts` + hardened `project-state.ts` + `tests/owner-only-path.test.ts` |
| **Socket chmod-after-listen TOCTOU** | **Mostly fixed** | `src/runtime/secure-socket.ts` used by daemon, run-tool, broker |

## Still open (small leftovers)

1. **`src/runtime/os-sandbox.ts`** staged Linux relay probe still does `listen` → `chmodSync(0o600)` (short-lived probe, not the main control plane).
2. **No `tests/secure-socket.test.ts`** yet.
3. **Stale assert** in `tests/daemon.test.ts` may still expect socket mode `0o600` while secure bind yields **`0o700`** (stricter).
4. Possible dead **`chmodSync` imports** in daemon / run-tool / broker.

## Bottom line

**4 of 5 issues fully fixed; 1 mostly fixed** on the primary paths (daemon, run-tool, broker sockets). Highest-value items — token-in-URL, weak HMAC keys, owner-only trust roots, broker TCP surface — are in the tree with tests.

I can close the fix-2 leftovers (os-sandbox + secure-socket tests + daemon mode assert) in this seat if you want.

## Fix-2 leftovers closed

All four residual items from the security continuation are done.

| Change | Detail |
|---|---|
| **os-sandbox probe** | Staged Linux relay bind uses `umask 0o077` around `listen`; no more `chmodSync`-after-listen |
| **Dead imports** | Removed unused `chmodSync` from `daemon/server.ts`, `run-tool-endpoint.ts`, `broker/server.ts` |
| **Stale daemon assert** | `tests/daemon.test.ts` expects socket mode **`0o700`** (secure bind) |
| **Regression tests** | Added `tests/secure-socket.test.ts` (owner-only mode, permissive umask override, umask restore on success/fail, connect-after-listen, `assertSecureSocket` rejects, `secureBunUnixServe`) |

### Tests
```
bun test tests/daemon.test.ts tests/secure-socket.test.ts \
         tests/broker.test.ts tests/linux-broker-relay.test.ts
→ 84 pass, 2 skip, 0 fail
```

### Security fix loop — final scorecard
| ID | Status |
|---|---|
| fix-1 path-trust | **fixed** |
| fix-2 socket TOCTOU | **fixed** (primary + probe + tests) |
| fix-3 `?key=` tokens | **fixed** |
| fix-4 broker TCP gate | **fixed** |
| fix-5 ledger HMAC floor | **fixed** |

All five confirmed issues are closed on the primary paths.
